notes: The spec's number to string conversion writes the digits of the integer part and any non-zero fractional part, and says nothing about negative zero; numbers are equal when numerically equal, so -0 is arguably the value 0 and would convert to "0". hashicorp/hcl negates 0 into a negative zero big.Float, and go-cty's number to string conversion (cty/convert/conversion_primitive.go) formats it with big.Float.Text, which writes "-0".
